title: Keep an observed execution alias retained while its completion wait is pending
outcome: A wait naming an observed execution id retains access to its canonical terminal observation while a launcher run compacts that observation as an associated row; an in-flight non-durable compaction does not prematurely settle the wait as unavailable.
acceptance: Pending observation waits cover aliases absorbed into a launcher compaction entry, or otherwise stay pending while the corresponding compacted entry is not yet installed; unknown or foreign execution ids remain refused.

A deterministic test places compaction before wait refresh and controls its durability acknowledgement, showing that the wait delivers the real terminal result once without an intermediate unavailable result.
